definitions.explanation: The formal ceremony celebrating a marriage.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}に{招待|しょうたい}された。
examples.english: I was invited to the wedding.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{来月|らいげつ}です。
{教会|きょうかい}で{結婚式|けっこんしき}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: We had our wedding ceremony at a church.

notes:
{結婚式|けっこんしき} refers to the formal wedding ceremony itself. In Japan, the ceremony ({結婚式|けっこんしき}) is usually followed by a reception ({披露宴|ひろうえん}), which are often treated as separate events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}を{挙|あ}げる: to hold a wedding ceremony
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend a wedding
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}に{招待|しょうたい}する: to invite to a wedding
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}: wedding venue

TYPES:
- {神前式|しんぜんしき}: Shinto-style wedding (at a shrine)
- {教会式|きょうかいしき}: church-style wedding (most popular style)
- {人前式|じんぜんしき}: secular ceremony (vows before guests)

RELATED TERMS:
- {披露宴|ひろうえん}: wedding reception (formal banquet)
- {二次会|にじかい}: casual after-party
- ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}: monetary gift (typically given in odd-numbered amounts like 30,000 or 50,000 yen)
